title: The Throne in the Clouds
text: Above the sixth shrine a throne of storm sits empty but for the one on it. Lightning walks in his beard and the clouds kneel at his feet. He offers strength to anyone who will call him king, and asks only that you kneel too, and leave a little of yourselves behind.

options.label: Kneel among the clouds, and call him king.

outcomes.text: The thunder goes into your arms. Something of each of you stays kneeling there when you rise.

options.label: Refuse him, under his own sky.

outcomes.text: He rises from his throne of storm, and the lightning rises with him.

options.label: Take the lightning, and stay standing.

outcomes.text: The leader takes the lightning and does not kneel. The Thunderer laughs, and stands.
He sees it coming. The lightning goes the other way, through the leader's ribs.
